name: zebra-bi
description: The Zebra BI MCP with skills: interactive IBCS-style charts and tables of your business data, variance explanations, and data stories you can export as a PDF or as PowerPoint and Excel files with live Zebra BI visuals.

interface.longDescription: Zebra BI draws business data as interactive IBCS-style charts and tables, inline in the conversation. Give it actuals with a previous year, previous month, plan or forecast, and it draws the variances, with good and bad differences marked. Time periods are drawn as charts, other categories as tables with inline charts. Hand it a dataset and its skills tell a data story: one key message, the findings that prove it, and a Zebra BI chart under each one.
defaultPrompt: Chart monthly sales against last year: Jan 42 vs 38, Feb 45 vs 44, Mar 51 vs 47.
Compare actual costs with budget: rent 12 vs 12, staff 58 vs 52, travel 9 vs 6.
Chart actual against plan by region: North 120 vs 100, South 80 vs 95, West 140 vs 130.
